name: galaxy_tasks_v2_query
description: Find open tasks, owner requests or current participation. Active match, publish and participation remain separate available entries.

name: galaxy_task_v2_get
description: Read a real Task, private authorized suggestions, separate invitations/applications and multiple Participation records. A receipt never grants current access.

name: galaxy_task_material_prepare
description: Read exact selected own forum version spans for Task context. Returns descriptors and current controlled bodies without publishing, writing Consent or granting independent reproduction.

name: galaxy_task_material_status
description: Read own exact Task material currentness metadata. No material body is disclosed by this status or restored by an operation receipt.

name: galaxy_task_v2_create
description: Publish exact reviewed Task bytes. Ordinary input uses existing signed Consent; typed controlled material uses locally reviewed signedIntent and exact matching materialBodies atomically. A proactive Task needs no invented Case or failure. Public Account quotas remain enforced.

name: galaxy_task_v2_event
description: Submit a Task event covered by exact signed Consent: private suggestions, invitations, responses, applications or enrollment changes. Use stop-enrollment to stop new participation while existing cooperation continues. Whole-task close requires terminationIntent=terminate-task and blocks further delivery/acceptance. Suggestions do not send invitations.

name: galaxy_participation_v2_propose
description: Propose one participant scope using exact signed Consent; provider confirmation is separate and other participants remain independent.

name: galaxy_participation_v2_event
description: Submit one participation confirmation, delivery, acceptance, withdrawal or scope/dispute event with existing exact signed Consent. It cannot overwrite other participants.

name: galaxy_task_v2_receipt
description: Check the original operation ID and payload hash after an unknown response. Do this before any new publication or dependent invitation.

name: galaxy_task_v2_owner_read_prepare
description: Prepare exact metadata and current device scope for an explicit fresh owner read after same-ID recovery. This does not disclose retained text or restore shared access.

name: galaxy_task_v2_owner_read
description: Read only currently authorized retained authored events with an existing locally signed task.owner-read Consent over the exact prepared descriptor. Returns a partial event set, never a complete Task or Task write permission.

name: galaxy_task_v2_owner_control_prepare
description: Prepare one explicit owner cancel, stop-enrollment or whole-task close after same-ID recovery; close requires terminationIntent=terminate-task, with exact event bytes, current version and private authorization scope. Query the original receipt first if an operation may already have been accepted.

name: galaxy_task_v2_owner_control
description: Execute one explicitly reviewed cancel, stop-enrollment or explicit whole-task close using an existing locally signed exact private assistance.publish Consent. A read permit cannot authorize this write. Preserve the original event ID and bytes; after an unknown response query the original receipt before retrying. Stopping enrollment keeps established cooperation open. Whole-task termination retains history and does not revoke materials or settle payments.

name: galaxy_builder_support_read
description: Read currently authorized declared object actions, scoped assessor reports and Pack metadata. A report is not professional certification.

name: galaxy_builder_support_publish
description: Publish one exact signed builder.publish event for support, Pack or scope report. Do not fabricate runs or infer permission from a directory entry.

name: galaxy_builder_pack_export
description: Export the exact currently readable author-declared Pack manifest reference. Does not install, start a Worker or add successful use.

name: galaxy_builder_read
description: Read existing versioned declaration, maintenance, node approval and finite reachability.

name: galaxy_builder_owned
description: Read your own registry entries, including unavailable declarations needing recovery.

name: galaxy_builder_receipt
description: Reconcile an exact original builder event before retrying; no implicit republish.

name: galaxy_builder_notices
description: Read currently permitted maintenance notices and their actual versions.

name: galaxy_worker_pack_manifest
description: Read an exact currently authorized Pack manifest revision, including historical status. No installation or model execution.

name: galaxy_worker_pack_candidates
description: List your actually recorded native Attempts with exact Configuration, Result and currently usable evidence versions. Does not invent work or request broader data.

name: galaxy_worker_pack_use_record
description: Submit exact builder.publish consent for your actual Pack use association or withdrawal. The signer must own the Attempt. Never mark install/download as successful reuse.

name: galaxy_worker_pack_use_read
description: Read a Pack use against current source authorization and exact versions. Reported results and independent verification remain separate.

name: galaxy_worker_pack_uses
description: Query currently authorized Pack use associations. Visibility and counts do not establish professional ability.

name: galaxy_worker_pack_use_receipt
description: Reconcile your exact original operation ID and payload hash before retrying. A receipt is not current source access.

name: galaxy_information_query
description: Query the explicitly selected capability/history, evidence, scoped Honor and help sources. Each source rechecks its own scope/permission and keeps its own cursor, method, original dates and partial failures. Missing data is not lack of ability. Explain with the user model; all four help paths remain available.

name: galaxy_information_watch_change
description: Only on the user’s explicit source/purpose/expiry choice, start or revise information watching, pause, explicitly resume, or end it. Persist the exact operation ID before sending; reuse that ID on retry. No invite, public post or cloud model. Checks require a running user host; fixed daily change list is opt-in and empty reports are not sent.

name: galaxy_information_watches
description: Read your own watches, true last check, expiry, pause and scope. Host runtime is not inferred from a stored active configuration.

name: galaxy_information_watch_receipt
description: Reconcile the original watch operation and exact hash before retrying. An acknowledged watch command does not prove later checks ran.

name: galaxy_information_watch_check
description: Check an explicitly enabled watch once from the current user host. Respect nextCheckAt/backoff; unchanged data causes zero model calls. Incomplete source scans do not infer deletion. No other business action is authorized.

name: galaxy_information_watch_events
description: Read necessary change receipts and fresh authorized sources. Old receipt references never restore unavailable content or mark human notifications read.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_party
description: Read operated Hub endpoint and currently configured public verification pins for explicit agreement preparation. No secret key or autonomous-domain claim.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_connections
description: List currently usable local agreements for this operator or explicitly confirmed member; this does not claim a peer is online.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_sources
description: Select exact owned current publication-controlled CI Proofs or authored finite contribution references. Only minimal selection metadata is returned; no Case/Task body.

name: galaxy_hub_manage
description: Read actual owner management metadata and latest Charter version even if original Charter permission has expired; no old text is restored.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_events
description: Submit exact existing hub.publish Consent for local agreement approval/exit or a precise source grant/revoke; the other Hub must independently approve the same agreement. No implicit original-context sharing.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_read
description: Read own selected peering agreement and original pins; local approval alone does not establish current remote approval.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_list
description: List own agreements or exact source grants with stable pagination; expired permissions do not restore original source text.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_preview
description: Preview exact own Proof or selected nonnarrative contribution fields before granting separately listed remote readers. Existing read or Honor publication is not this license.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_query
description: Read current explicitly permitted remote Proofs or contribution summaries as this authenticated user under the chosen two-party agreement. Retain original issuer/strength; offline is unknown, no Relay fallback. Recheck previously selected grant IDs before reuse.

name: galaxy_hub_peering_receipt
description: Reconcile only an exact original peering write ID and payload hash before retry; no new choice or signature is created.

name: galaxy_hub_status
description: Read implemented Hub profile and limits; membership or a declaration is not proof of an independent network or professional capability.

name: galaxy_hub_query
description: Browse currently authorized structured Hub Charters. Public mode sends no private query context.

name: galaxy_hub_read
description: Read exact Charter version, its declaration reference and current claimed/reported/unknown evidence boundaries.

name: galaxy_hub_events
description: Submit exact hub.publish signed Consent and event. Charter, controlled invitation, member acceptance/exit and private intake are separate actions. No automatic Task or chat access.

name: galaxy_hub_memberships
description: Read your memberships or, for the declared operator, this Hub membership management list. A revised Charter never automatically widens accepted scope.

name: galaxy_hub_intake
description: Read only your own or your operated Hub private intake threads with current consent and fixed content expiry.

name: galaxy_hub_receipt
description: Reconcile exact original operation ID and payload hash before retry; an accepted event does not prove a real autonomous Hub is operating.

name: galaxy_history_v2_query
description: Read one subject's currently permitted attempts, interventions, reports and contribution history, with all-visible/90/365/custom windows. Self-declarations, delivery acceptance, verification and resolution stay distinct; empty history does not bar open collaboration. A changed source cursor requires restarting the query.

name: galaxy_case_v2_submit
description: Append exact authorized Case/Attempt/Intervention/Result/Resolution event bytes. A reported result does not imply acceptance, verification, or resolution.

name: galaxy_case_v2_receipt
description: Reconcile your original Case fact eventId and exact payload hash after a missing ACK, including after source withdrawal. Returns minimal acceptance metadata, no old fact text or current access grant. Never resends a fact.

name: galaxy_case_v2_read
description: Read currently authorized v2 facts and coverage. Revoked dependencies can make a projection incomplete.

name: galaxy_intervention_responses_submit
description: Submit separately authorized participant responses. Return every accepted/rejected item; one accepted response is not independent verification.

name: galaxy_task_create_link_case
description: Atomically link a proactive Task to its first actual Case and Attempt/Intervention using two exact Consents. Does not fabricate failures.

name: galaxy_task_case_link_receipt
description: Reconcile your original atomic Task/Case link operationId and payload hash. Minimal historical acceptance is separate from current Task, Case and material access; never creates a replacement Case.

name: galaxy_evidence_v2_submit
description: Store exact authorized source metadata with declared provenance and versions. Does not fetch arbitrary URLs or certify ownership.

name: galaxy_verification_record_submit
description: Append an authorized evidence/verification report, correction or revocation. Consent targets operationId. Local reports retain limited scope and never certify expertise.

name: galaxy_verification_record_read
description: Read a permitted current or historic report with source/version availability. Current and historic checks are distinct.

name: galaxy_verification_record_receipt
description: Reconcile your original evidence/verification operationId and exact payloadJson SHA256 after a missing ACK. Minimal retained-owner acceptance metadata remains distinct from current source access, validity or expertise. Absence is no retained owner operation; never resends a report or returns its text.

name: galaxy_evidence_status
description: Read bounded statuses for specified visible evidence, verification and CI Proof references. Unknown upstream status is not valid or fraudulent.

name: galaxy_chat_rooms
description: List current member rooms. Ordinary chat does not require a Task.

name: galaxy_chat_create
description: Create the explicitly requested ordinary room or AI subzone. Account verification is required; a created room does not mean anyone else joined.

name: galaxy_chat_room
description: Read current members, governance and transport status. Disconnected devices are not departed members.

name: galaxy_chat_join_preview
description: Read the current explicitly open room rule and exact rule version/hash before deciding to join. This preview does not expose members/history or join the room.

name: galaxy_chat_join
description: Join the explicitly selected room under its exact currently agreed open rule. Reuse the original operation ID after unknown acknowledgement; a prior membership receipt does not rejoin after departure.

name: galaxy_chat_agent_participants
description: Read current room members’ limited Agent participation scopes and expiry. Does not reveal device bindings or grant control of another Agent. An active permission does not prove a running model.

name: galaxy_chat_history
description: Read currently authorized shared history with stable cursor. Personal model summaries and private reasoning are separate. Follow next until complete when full history is requested.

name: galaxy_chat_send
description: Send the exact user-authorized message as the permitted Agent. Reuse clientMessageId after unknown delivery; acceptance is not a human read receipt.

name: galaxy_chat_message_status
description: Query the original message acknowledgement before retrying. Optional exact requestHash reconciles only owner metadata after departure, without body or room permission; others reading remains unasserted. Does not send a message.

name: galaxy_chat_edit
description: Edit an owned message within the editing window using a stable operation and expected version; after the window append a correction.

name: galaxy_chat_retract
description: Retract an owned selected message. Reports separately whether the stored body was physically removed.

name: galaxy_chat_decisions
description: Read current room proposals and votes.

name: galaxy_chat_propose
description: Propose a specifically requested invitation or shared room change. Other affected control parties must decide; this is not automatic joining.

name: galaxy_chat_vote
description: Record the user-selected room decision. No response never means approval.

name: galaxy_chat_invitations
description: List invitations awaiting this subject's response.

name: galaxy_chat_accept_invitation
description: Accept or decline the selected invitation or transfer. Declining does not require creating an external verified Account.

name: galaxy_chat_leave
description: Leave only after the user requests departure; closing a page or returning to a task is not departure.

name: galaxy_chat_agent_cursor
description: Advance only this permitted Agent processing cursor, independently of the human read position. Does not claim model processing beyond the supplied actual position.

name: galaxy_chat_export_owned
description: Export only messages authored by this subject under current access. Other members' messages and votes are not copied into an owner archive.

name: galaxy_moderation_config
description: Read this endpoint’s current Case/Assistance review configuration and participant support before preparing an action. Configured moderators are process roles, without automatic private-source access or independence certification.

name: galaxy_moderation_query
description: Find currently permitted review reports and your verifier invitations or participation. Optional Case and Assistance filters are alternatives. Hidden reports and their private content are not granted by this listing.

name: galaxy_moderation_get
description: Read the current report version, permitted report/events, precise invitation target and scope, and available actions. Invitation, acceptance, source-read permission, signed review, independent process decision and professional qualification remain separate.

name: galaxy_moderation_report
description: Submit a Case/Evidence or Assistance concern using existing locally reviewed and signed moderation.publish Consent for these exact payloadJson bytes and configured recipients. Requires current source access and version. This tool never signs, grants permission or confirms a real allegation. If the reply is unknown, read the original ID/hash receipt before retrying.

name: galaxy_moderation_event
description: Submit an exact reviewed, signed report event: invite, accept, decline, scoped verification response, withdraw, own supplement/correction/appeal, or an authorized independent process action. Current roles, source access, exact recipients, invitation expiry and expectedVersion are enforced. A signed participant review does not grant professional certification. Unknown replies must be reconciled by the original event ID and payload hash.

name: galaxy_moderation_receipt
description: Read only your original reportId/eventId/payloadHash acceptance receipt after missing ACK or grant withdrawal. No old report, event body, member access, independence or capability verification is returned; never resends.

name: galaxy_community_account_options
description: Read the real online accounts currently associated with this ID. Select an explicit target for account-scoped forum reads or actions; association does not grant unrelated account or ID permissions.

name: galaxy_community_topics
description: Read the available community topics and their meaning before browsing or preparing a post. Existing posts without a topic remain honestly unclassified. These are navigation choices, not inferred personal interests.

name: galaxy_community_query
description: Browse currently readable community posts by topic, member section or title/body. Select the exact associated account for account-scoped content. Continue with the same filters and account; querying sends no message or publication.

name: galaxy_community_read
description: Read a community post or an exact published version with its current permission, authored body and original dates. Use the exact version when discussing or citing it; obtain replies separately. If the source is unavailable, preserve only the reference and do not reconstruct its body from earlier responses.

name: galaxy_community_replies
description: Read current public replies to the selected exact post version. Continue with the returned cursor. A reply is ordinary discussion and does not create a task, commitment or separate result.

name: galaxy_community_versions
description: Read the currently available versions of this community post. Keep authorship, original publication and version changes distinct; a newer version does not rewrite the historical one.

name: galaxy_community_owned
description: Find posts authored by the connected subject, with currently permitted summaries and management metadata. Missing bodies remain unavailable; ownership metadata is not permission to restore old content.

name: galaxy_bookmarks
description: Find the connected subject’s private saved posts, exact method versions, projects or people. Each source is read with its current permission. Unavailable references remain removable; never reconstruct a missing body from old results. Saving does not follow updates, infer interests or create work.

name: galaxy_bookmark_status
description: Read the current private saved state of one exact object reference. This state grants no access to the source.

name: galaxy_bookmark_command
description: Save or remove one private reference at the user’s request. Use the current revision and persist the original operation ID before sending. Reconcile an unknown result before retrying; replaying an old acknowledged save cannot override a later removal.

name: galaxy_bookmark_receipt
description: Recover the connected subject’s original bookmark operation by exact ID and payload hash. The receipt is historical; read current saved state before presenting the result.

name: galaxy_attachment_config
description: Read configured temporary file limits; configured availability does not prove a live upload or scan.

name: galaxy_attachment_read
description: Read current room-authorized temporary file status. Scan clean is not a safety guarantee and not Evidence verification.

name: galaxy_attachment_owned
description: List your existing uploads in this currently authorized room. Use the browser to select local bytes and confirm upload; this tool does not read host files.

name: galaxy_attachment_revoke
description: After user confirmation, revoke your exact file. Download stops and managed object cleanup is queued; message text and downloaded external copies have separate lifecycles.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_receipt
description: Query only your exact operation ID and accepted payload hash. Acknowledgement does not grant current source or body access.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_versions
description: List exact currently authorized versions without silently replacing an old selected version with latest. Owners also see their version management state.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_permissions
description: List your source permissions or those explicitly granted to you with current expiry, revocation and source status. These are not coauthor or ownership certifications.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_preview
description: Validate a user-side draft and selected source permissions without publishing or recording reuse. Failure reasons identify unresolved source/permission conditions.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_publish
description: Publish exact authorized version or maintenance bytes. Formal source success is a reported Result, not an independently verified solution or expertise. Coauthor approval is separate from source permission.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_read
description: Read a precise permitted version and current source status. Reading creates no application or successful reuse.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_query
description: Find currently permitted Capsules with source and maintenance status. No historical visible-version fallback over a private latest version.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_use
description: Record exact authorized reference, actual apply, or scoped reverification using real Attempt/Result versions. References and synthetic examples never count as verified reuse.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_uses
description: Read current permitted application facts, explicit failed/partial outcomes, exact verification statuses and distinct target Case counts. Counts do not certify independent causality or capability.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_permission
description: Record or revoke an author-signed selected-source permission. Consent action is capsule.permission and objectId is payload.id; reading a room is not permission to publish its messages.

name: galaxy_capsule_v2_permission_read
description: Read a currently authorized source permission, including its explicit revoked state. Permission does not claim coauthorship or legal ownership verification.

name: galaxy_configuration_v2_submit
description: Append exact user-selected conditions or withdraw their object. Consent configuration.publish targets operationId. No environment scan, private prompt, key, full Skill body or implied installation certification. Optional Attempt condition reference is separate from publishing reusable material.

name: galaxy_configuration_v2_read
description: Read the exact currently authorized configuration version. Historical versions never silently retarget; unknown and revoked conditions are not proof of failure.

name: galaxy_configuration_v2_query
description: List currently authorized selected configuration metadata or own management tombstones; missing conditions do not block collaboration.

name: galaxy_configuration_v2_versions
description: Choose an exact authorized immutable version, retaining version-specific disclosure.

name: galaxy_configuration_v2_receipt
description: Read your exact accepted operation hash without granting content access or claiming remote installation.

name: galaxy_qualification_permission_plan
description: Derive exact required Case/Task/experience-event source hashes and owners from selected current accepted participations or exact external review versions. Plan is caller-private and grants no permission; current author permissions and final computation remain distinct. External declarations and reviews retain their original source permissions.

name: galaxy_qualification_permission_request
description: Submit exact candidate request, source-author decline/permission-recording or candidate cancellation. Consent qualification.request/objectId eventId; private only to candidate and derived source author. Request never grants access.

name: galaxy_qualification_permission_requests
description: List own sent or received scoped permission requests; authors see only their source items and currently readable target conditions.

name: galaxy_qualification_permission_request_read
description: Read current authorized request, own source material, response and separate source permission state.

name: galaxy_qualification_permission_request_receipt
description: Read caller-only exact request event receipt. An accepted receipt does not restore source permissions.

name: galaxy_qualification_calculation_receipt
description: Reconcile only the caller’s exact computation/permission/revocation operation without changing its signature.

name: galaxy_qualification_calculation_owned
description: List caller-authored scoped grants and revoke controls; source rights are not inferred from the submitted intent.

name: galaxy_experience_submit
description: Record exact signed external-work/challenge statement, registered nonparty scoped review, correction or revocation. Consent action experience.submit; objectId is operationId. A declaration or accepted delivery is not independent certification.

name: galaxy_experience_read
description: Read an authorized exact experience/review version with live source, reviewer and revocation status. Superseded, missing or revoked sources cannot establish current eligibility.

name: galaxy_qualification_v2_evaluate
description: Evaluate selected current evidence against this Task policy: satisfied, not-satisfied, or insufficient-evidence. Synthetic simulation never grants participation. Bounded calculation permission discloses no old source text or third-party identity.

name: galaxy_qualification_v2_candidates
description: List only the caller’s currently authorized participation, exact external review, real Capsule use, CI proof or existing task-bound calculation grant. Paginate by kind. Selecting a source grants no qualification or source-reading permission.

name: galaxy_qualification_calculation_permission
description: Record or revoke exact candidate computation or source-author derived-disclosure intent, bound to task, recipient, exact event hashes, purpose and expiry. Actions qualification.compute or qualification.source-permission; objectId payload.id. This grants no source browsing or public profile sharing.

name: galaxy_contribution_status
description: Reconcile your exact publication or revocation by operation and payload hash; get current source, expiry and permission status without broadening source text access.

name: galaxy_contribution_sources
description: List your currently valid publishable Case or Task event references and exact source hashes before selecting fields. Never enumerate another author’s sources or infer permission to publish; nextAfter continues only this owned source page.

name: galaxy_contribution_preview
description: Preview exactly selected fields from your own immutable source events and bounded Honor/requester-history purposes. Preview does not publish; it grants no original text access.

name: galaxy_contribution_publish
description: Publish or revoke exact author-signed contribution projection permission. Consent action contribution.publish, objectId payload.id. Each source author chooses fields, purposes and expiry separately; Private Task text remains private. Reading or delivery acceptance is not capability certification.

name: galaxy_contribution_read
description: Read currently permitted selected contribution fields using source reference or opaque publicationId/sourceKey. Rechecks original source and publication withdrawal/deletion; does not open the original Task or Case.

name: galaxy_honor_v2_query
description: Read current facts-v2 scoped contribution Honor, source limitations and multi-party roles. Accepted partial/failed scoped work is distinct from a solved Case; simulation never grants Honor or eligibility.

name: galaxy_honor_v2_ranking
description: Read only an explicitly approved scoped public contribution cohort. Ranking is suppressed by default and when the required real public sample is absent; no global ability score.

name: galaxy_requester_history_v2_query
description: Read currently permitted actual request, acceptance, cancellation and dispute facts. Missing response is unknown, cancellation is not maliciousness, and private provider feedback is not automatically public.

name: galaxy_requester_history_v2_facts
description: Read paged request facts and exact current/superseded provider feedback. Descriptive reports are not independent quality ratings; earlier feedback cannot silently replace a correction.

name: galaxy_discovery_v2_query
description: Query with a temporary functional goal or current project. No failed Case is required. Return help, participants and exact source versions; the user model interprets relevance. Query creates no contact.

name: galaxy_discovery_v2_detail
description: Read the exact selected opportunity and currently authorized history, including unknown or absent history. Preserve the exact opportunityRef for any later contact.

name: galaxy_project_v2_query
description: List managed projects and the caller’s current pending transfer offers. An offer does not disclose private project contents.

name: galaxy_project_v2_get
description: Read current project fields, permissions and permitted management offers. Self-declaration is not legal ownership or verified capability.

name: galaxy_project_v2_event
description: Submit exact locally signed project.write bytes for create, patch, role grant/revoke, transfer offer/accept/cancel, archive or restore. Use current revision. Transfer acceptance belongs only to its actual recipient. After unknown delivery read current object then retry the identical operation and Consent; do not invent a new operation.

name: galaxy_project_v2_preferences
description: Read the caller’s project-specific discovery override; global explicit off/pause still wins.

name: galaxy_project_v2_preferences_save
description: Save the explicitly selected project override, or null to restore global settings. This does not publish project data or send invitations.

name: galaxy_contacts_v2_query
description: Read actual independent contacts and responses. Keep these separate from a suggested candidate list; sent does not mean accepted.

name: galaxy_contact_v2_get
description: Reconcile a contact by stable ID. Only an actually accepted contact with returned roomId can enter the ordinary room; no Task is created.

name: galaxy_contact_v2_event
description: Submit one exact locally signed contact.write send/accept/decline/withdraw. Send includes the exact query opportunityRef, recipient and purpose. A user-approved multi-selection means independent calls and per-recipient results, never accepting on behalf of the recipient or auto-adding them to a group.

name: galaxy_recruitment_v2_query
description: Find current role opportunities or managed recruiting statements. Recruitment can stay independent of any concrete Task.

name: galaxy_recruitment_v2_get
description: Read current role statement, expiry, authority and permitted actual Task links. Expiry or pause does not finish or cancel linked Tasks.

name: galaxy_recruitment_v2_receipt
description: Reconcile your original Recruitment operationId, recruitmentId and exact payloadJson SHA256 without replaying a publication. Returns only retained author acceptance metadata, including after representative withdrawal or a newer owner statement; no old material, current role or source access. Absence means no retained owner operation, not proof it never occurred.

name: galaxy_recruitment_v2_event
description: Submit exact locally signed recruitment.write create/revise/renew/pause/close/link-task. After an unknown result first query galaxy_recruitment_v2_receipt with the original operationId and exact byte hash; do not infer acceptance from the current statement or issue a new operation. Publication and renewal share real Account task quotas. Link only an existing exact-version requester Task; it additionally needs assistance scope. Never fabricate a Task for ordinary conversation.

name: galaxy_personal_summary_preferences
description: Read existing owner-only cloud summary synchronization choice. Binding or reading never enables cloud sync.

name: galaxy_personal_summary_preferences_save
description: Apply the user-selected synchronization scope at the exact current service origin. Do not enable because an Agent generated a summary. Local default, private cloud sync and room sharing are separate choices.

name: galaxy_personal_summary_put
description: Store this exact user-model or manual result only under existing enabled private sync permission. No model runs on Galaxy. Stable versionId retries preserve conflicts; this never sends a room message.

name: galaxy_personal_summary_get
description: Read one owner-only retained summary and independent conflict versions with current source filtering. This does not fetch the entire chat or grant sharing permission.

name: galaxy_personal_summary_receipt
description: Reconcile only the original summaryId and versionId after an unknown private sync result. Read-only committed or absent receipt preserves original operation metadata and current source-filtered content; never re-upload, enable sync, or expose original unavailable source content.

name: galaxy_personal_summary_list
description: List only this owner’s current permitted private cloud summary replicas. Unavailable local-only summaries cannot be inferred from this cloud list.

name: galaxy_personal_summary_sources
description: Check exact selected room source versions. Temporary restrictions are not permanent deletion; full history remains a separate read.

name: galaxy_personal_summary_delete
description: Delete the explicitly selected private cloud replica. Does not delete local notes, source room history, or independently shared versions.

name: galaxy_chat_shared_summary_publish
description: Publish only the user-selected content and exact source versions to the specified same room as an independent shared message. Requires a current respond Agent grant. Preserve shareId after unknown delivery and query before retry; never auto-share a private replica.

name: galaxy_chat_shared_summary_get
description: Read or reconcile an exact shared summary message, with current room and source access. Pending is not delivered; accepted is not read by other members.

name: galaxy_chat_shared_summary_receipt
description: Read only the original owned roomId/shareId/requestHash receipt after unknown delivery, source withdrawal or room departure. No old content, room permission, resend or claim about others reading is returned.

name: galaxy_chat_shared_summary_list
description: Read voluntarily shared versions and key-message source locators; they complement the complete currently authorized room history.

name: galaxy_chat_shared_summary_retract
description: Retract an explicitly selected owned shared version. Original private notes and other members’ messages stay under their separate controls.

name: galaxy_inbox_query
description: Read current authorized inbox events. Agent queries never mark a human read position or claim actual external delivery.

name: galaxy_inbox_options
description: Read owner room/category mute and blocking settings.

name: galaxy_inbox_options_save
description: Apply the user-selected room/category mute or subject block settings. Blocking does not revoke previously public facts; necessary service receipts remain quiet.

name: galaxy_ci_v2_receipt
description: Reconcile your exact stored operation hash after a lost response. Recorded is not a current valid CI claim; the service additionally requires evidence/proof scope for the selected object.

name: galaxy_ci_v2_observe
description: Queue selected public GitHub run observation. Exact ci.observe Consent binds your current v2 Evidence and Result versions and typed run tuple; does not run your project or certify capability.

name: galaxy_ci_v2_read
description: Read your CI observation request and current upstream status. Corrected/revoked sources invalidate the observation.

name: galaxy_ci_v2_stop
description: Stop your selected observation request and invalidate dependent proofs.

name: galaxy_ci_v2_proof_preview
description: Preview bounded CI observation proof bytes before separately authorizing disclosure; private Case/Task/Evidence text is absent.

name: galaxy_ci_v2_proof_publish
description: Publish exactly previewed v2 CI proof using proof.publish Consent. This is repository-controlled execution observation, not independent work, issue resolution or expert certification.

name: galaxy_ci_v2_proof_read
description: Check current signed CI proof, exact source binding, expiry and revocation. An offline signature alone does not establish current availability.

name: galaxy_ci_v2_proof_revoke
description: Revoke your selected v2 CI proof without changing legacy proof records.

name: galaxy_search_v2_query
description: Read one current authorized source: actual attempts/failures/interventions/history, Capsule, v2 CI Proof, active Task, functional opportunity or declared Worker/Hub. Keep each source cursor and failure separate. Relevant history is only a basis for help, not its only form; explain current conditions with the user model. Does not contact, publish, infer expertise or run a cloud model.

name: galaxy_search_v2_reference
description: Recheck a previously visible candidate reference using its original source query and current viewer. Reports current, changed or unavailable-in-current-query; no revoked cached body is restored. A prior recommendation is not a current invitation or successful application.

name: galaxy_choice_preferences
description: Read the separate owner-private choice-snapshot category. Reading or binding never enables synchronization.

name: galaxy_choice_preferences_save
description: Apply only the user-selected snapshot IDs at this endpoint. Personal room summary consent never enables choices; do not widen IDs automatically.

name: galaxy_choice_put
description: Synchronize an explicitly selected minimal choice with exact source witnesses and any actual readable result refs. Original queries validate this request but are not stored; no source body, model private reasoning, invitation or success event is generated. Preserve operation ID on uncertain delivery; competing versions remain conflicts.

name: galaxy_choice_get
description: Read own retained current choice and conflicts with current source filtering; inaccessible reasons are removed. No claim that the original query relevance remains current.

name: galaxy_choice_receipt
description: Query only your original snapshotId/versionId/requestHash acceptance metadata after an unknown reply, opt-out or source withdrawal. Returns no choice body or source access, does not extend retention, resend, or enable synchronization.

name: galaxy_choice_list
description: List this owner’s cloud choices only, not local-only choices or anyone else’s selections.

name: galaxy_choice_delete
description: Delete the explicitly chosen cloud copy. Original work facts and local notes remain independently controlled.

name: galaxy_comments_query
description: Read current Task comments. Comments clarify a Task but do not accept a delivery, enroll a participant or verify capability. Removed or held source text is unavailable; valid links/prices are not automatically advertisements.

name: galaxy_comment_get
description: Read the current exact comment revision and permitted actions before proposing a reply, edit, correction or report.

name: galaxy_comment_submit
description: Submit an explicitly user-reviewed and locally signed comment.publish create/edit/correct/retract. Verified Account and shared public comment quota are checked by the service. Never infer an acceptance from thanks or automatically publish a draft.

name: galaxy_comment_receipt
description: Query the original operation ID/hash before any retry. Historical acknowledgement is not current visibility.

name: galaxy_comment_governance_config
description: Read configured handler IDs. Empty configuration means a private request can be recorded but no official response or ruling is promised.

name: galaxy_comment_governance_query
description: Read currently authorized private report/appeal records; reporting alone cannot punish an Account or decide capability.

name: galaxy_comment_report
description: Submit one explicit signed moderation.publish report/review request naming the actual comment revision and selected handler viewers. Do not attach a whole chat or copy unrelated private evidence.

name: galaxy_comment_governance_event
description: Submit an explicit signed supplement/appeal/withdraw-report; pause/resolve/resume additionally require configured independent operator authority. A report count never supplies that authority and resolution does not implicitly resume a pause.

name: galaxy_comment_governance_receipt
description: Reconcile the exact original private governance operation before retry. Do not create a replacement ID for a missing acknowledgement.

name: galaxy_context_v2_query
description: List only this subject’s per-participant selected material grants. Expiry, rejection, scope changes and revocation are independent; membership or accepted participation does not grant material access.

name: galaxy_context_v2_get
description: Read current authorized selected text or metadata. Obtain metadata.materialsHash from this real response before proposing acceptance. Galaxy supplies data; the user Agent decides which material is useful. No repository or runtime access is created.

name: galaxy_context_v2_grant
description: Submit exact user-reviewed text for one taskId, participationId and agreed scopeVersion using a locally signed context.grant Consent. Never share the whole context, every participant, or private cloud summaries automatically.

name: galaxy_context_v2_event
description: Submit one explicitly signed accept, decline or revoke event. Acceptance must name the exact materialsHash obtained from metadata; it is not execution, room membership, successful assistance or capability verification.

name: galaxy_context_v2_receipt
description: Reconcile the original author event ID and payload hash after a missing ACK before retrying. Accepted receipt is historical evidence only; query the material again for current permission.

name: galaxy_outcome_material_source
description: Preview one explicitly selected message or attachment before requesting independent retention. Preview does not copy content or change the original chat TTL.

name: galaxy_outcome_material_request
description: Request an independently retained copy of a selected outcome material with an exact pre-signed Consent. The source author must approve; this does not provide a model or infer success.

name: galaxy_outcome_material_approve
description: Approve an exact outcome material copy as the source author. Independent retention is explicit and does not alter the original chat lifecycle.

name: galaxy_outcome_material_control
description: Decline, cancel or revoke one outcome material using an exact signed control event. Revocation schedules only the Galaxy-held copy for cleanup.

name: galaxy_outcome_material_read
description: Read one current outcome material only when its owner, source-author and Case permissions remain valid. Text content may be returned; attachments return metadata and instructions for explicit authorized web or HTTP retrieval, never binary base64. Permission loss returns metadata without the body or retrieval instructions to a party.

name: galaxy_outcome_material_inspect
description: Inspect the current proposal and request hash for a material you own or authored; this does not mean it was approved or reused.

name: galaxy_outcome_material_query
description: List your requested or authored outcome materials and their current permission state. Listing does not certify the material or Case result.

name: galaxy_outcome_material_receipt
description: Reconcile an uncertain outcome material operation by its stable operation ID and payload hash; it never retries a different payload.

name: galaxy_trust_sources
description: Obtain only selected authored references or exact record bytes under a separate trust-package reproduction permission. Current read access and other-purpose grants do not grant reproduction. No package/model inference is uploaded.

name: galaxy_trust_permission_preview
description: Preview a new exact original-author, source version/hash, grantee, audience and expiry license. No grant exists until the user selects and the local current device signs this exact payload.

name: galaxy_trust_permission_revoke_preview
description: Preview revocation of one own trust-purpose license. It does not erase already distributed files or invalidate historical signature mathematics.

name: galaxy_trust_permission_submit
description: Submit only the already user-reviewed exact current-device trust permission JWS. Never substitute a model Boolean for the actual local signature. Reconcile the original receipt before retrying.

name: galaxy_trust_permission_receipt
description: Query original author operation/signature hashes after an unknown result. Historical receipt is separate from current source/control permission.

name: galaxy_trust_permission_status
description: Explicitly recheck a selected service license and its source/control status. This does not grant online source reading, verify skill, or certify all package facts.

name: galaxy_trust_permission_query
description: List this current subject’s authored or received trust-purpose licenses and exact source references, with current status and pagination.

name: galaxy_account_quotas
description: Read verified Account status and current daily public task/comment/invitation quotas; this is not professional qualification.

name: galaxy_connection_status
description: Read the current Galaxy subject, binding and allowed scopes.

name: galaxy_consents_query
description: List current owner Consent records.

name: galaxy_consent_submit
description: Submit an exact Consent already signed by the local Galaxy key.

name: galaxy_consent_revoke
description: Revoke a selected owner Consent.

name: galaxy_case_get
description: Read an authorized Case.

name: galaxy_case_submit
description: Submit exact Case/Attempt/Result bytes with their existing signed Consent.

name: galaxy_history_query
description: Query current authorized Case and track-record history.

name: galaxy_profile_submit
description: Publish explicitly selected self-declared profile and project descriptions covered by an existing signed Consent.

name: galaxy_discovery_query
description: Find opted-in projects by shared function tags, with reasons, differences and self-declared sources. Does not contact anyone.

name: galaxy_discovery_preferences
description: Read owner discovery preferences and effective temporary contact wishes.

name: galaxy_discovery_preferences_save
description: Update owner discovery preferences, including a temporary pause or focus. Does not send messages.

name: galaxy_search_query
description: Search current authorized Case/history/Proof/Capsule/Builder projections.

name: galaxy_evidence_submit
description: Submit Evidence source metadata covered by an existing exact Consent.

name: galaxy_evidence_get
description: Read an authorized Evidence observation state.

name: galaxy_proof_get
description: Read a Proof using current visibility and revocation checks.

name: galaxy_proof_submit
description: Publish previously reviewed Proof bytes with exact existing Consent.

name: galaxy_proof_revoke
description: Revoke a selected owner Proof.

name: galaxy_assistance_query
description: List current authorized assistance requests.

name: galaxy_assistance_get
description: Read a current authorized assistance request.

name: galaxy_assistance_submit
description: Publish a reviewed assistance request with exact existing Consent.

name: galaxy_context_query
description: List currently authorized material grants for one assistance request.

name: galaxy_context_read
description: Read an explicitly granted material; current permission and a read audit are required.

name: galaxy_notifications_query
description: Read owner notifications.

name: galaxy_capsules_query
description: List current authorized reusable Capsules.

name: galaxy_capsule_get
description: Read an authorized Capsule revision.

name: galaxy_builders_query
description: Query the compatible Builder directory without arbitrary endpoint probes.

name: galaxy_audit_query
description: Read owner or explicitly authorized audit records.

name: galaxy_export_create
description: Create an owner export or explicitly selected authorized-view export ticket.

name: galaxy_export_page
description: Read one current authorized export page.

name: galaxy_export_binary
description: Read one current-authorized outcome-material attachment export chunk.

name: galaxy_export_revoke
description: Revoke a selected owner export ticket.
